title: Social media use and well-being: A prospective experience-sampling study
limitations: - Small sample size; - Lack of diversity in sample (Android users only); - Single-item measures for constructs; - Did not account for motivations of SNS use; - Assumptions of multivariate normality and stationarity may not be fully met; - No formal test for centrality differences between groups.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. The authors mention using ESM and network analysis to address limitations of previous cross-sectional studies, but do not reference any preregistration platform. Code and data availability are declared in the paper but specific links or repositories are not provided in the text.
